Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to create BrightGrid in our vendor master so Procurement and AP can route POs and payments. To finish the setup we need the following items:

- Legal business name (as registered) + DBA if applicable
- Tax ID / W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax form
- Legal entity address (registered address) and remit address for invoices
- Primary AP contact for PO/invoice receipt (name + email + phone)
- Authorized signatory for contract/PO acceptance (name, title, email)
- Preferred payment method (ACH or wire) and a sample banking stub for verification

If you prefer, you can upload these to the vendor portal link I just invited you to — attached is the portal invite stub. Otherwise feel free to reply with the files.

Aim: once we have these, I can push a vendor record and share the PO routing path (we use email + our ERP mapping). Expected timeline on your side?

Thanks,
Ben

Hi Samantha —

Received, thanks — helpful and complete. A couple quick clarifying asks from AP before we finalize:

1) Can you confirm the remit address should be used for the PO "Bill To" or only invoices? We sometimes need separate "Ship/Deliver" addresses for services vs. invoice remit.
2) For ACH, AP requires an ACH authorization (DocuSign) naming the legal entity and the bank account holder exactly as on the W-9. I can send a DocuSign link for your CFO to e-sign; would David Chen be the right signer?
3) Do you have a preferred PO cadence (weekly/monthly) or are we best to send POs on a per-invoice basis? That helps mapping in ERP.

Kimberly — tagging you for AP intake and to confirm whether the attached banking stub format is sufficient for our vendor verification.

If all good I will create the vendor record today and route POs to rosa.martinez@brightgrid.io.

Thanks,
Ben
